question: Does the universal +90-degree route phase survive full ordinary-geometry refits on the chronological A383/MS2137 formula-transfer systems?

chronology.reason: A383 and MS2137 were used by earlier field families and P0616, but the P0618 +90-degree support-phase formula was frozen before evaluating it on either system.

fit.baseline_replay: P0616 scalar control used the same initial geometry, starts, and seed

claim_limits: The formula chronology is prospective relative to P0618 but neither system is a pristine project holdout.
MS2137's P0616 scalar baseline is root-incomplete, so its RMS comparison remains inconclusive unless both variants become complete.
The CLASH member-light proxy omits gas, diffuse intracluster light, contamination corrections, and stellar mass-to-light variation.
Six conventional lens-geometry variables and training-family source positions are refitted; these are ordinary nuisance parameters, not gravity settings.
A successful A383 response would still require more chronologically frozen complete-baseline systems and an absolute error competitive with halo models.
